text: Justine, a lifelong vegetarian, starts at the veterinary school where her older sister Alexia studies and their parents met. During a week of hazing the freshers are drenched in blood, and Alexia [makes her swallow a raw rabbit kidney|trigger|breaking a rule]. A rash spreads over her skin, then [a hunger she is ashamed of|threat|the enemy within] drives her from a stolen burger to raw chicken to [her sister's severed finger|images|corpses and body parts], as [an appetite that runs in the family|origin|family blood and inheritance] begins to surface.
